en.headline: Worker dies two weeks after Tai Kok Tsui tank fall
en.dek: A 62-year-old man died on Friday morning after falling at The Long Beach on 17 September.
body: A 62-year-old worker who fell while repairing a water tank at a Tai Kok Tsui estate has died, about two weeks after the accident. He was confirmed dead at 4:32 a.m. on Friday at Queen Elizabeth Hospital, according to reports of the police investigation.

The fall happened at about 7:19 p.m. on 17 September at The Long Beach, 10 Hoi Fai Road. Security staff told police the man had fallen about three metres from a water tank in the basement car park and struck his head. He was unconscious when ambulance crews took him to hospital. Police are treating the case as an industrial accident.

He was reported to have been working for a pump-engineering contractor at the time. Police said they would arrange a post-mortem to establish the direct cause of death, and were still examining the work arrangements and the site.

zh.headline: 大角咀男工維修水箱墮下 留醫兩周後不治
zh.dek: 62歲男工9月17日在瓏璽墮下約3米，周五清晨於伊利沙伯醫院證實死亡。
body: 大角咀私人屋苑一名維修水箱時墮下的62歲男工，事隔約兩星期後不治。據報道引述警方調查，他周五清晨4時32分在伊利沙伯醫院證實死亡。
意外發生於9月17日晚上約7時19分，地點是海輝道10號瓏璽。屋苑保安報稱，事主在地庫停車場維修一個約3米高的水箱時墮下，頭部受傷昏迷，由救護車送院。警方將案件列作工業意外跟進。
現場消息指，事主受僱於一間水泵工程公司。警方表示會安排驗屍以確定直接死因，並繼續調查事發時的工作程序及現場環境。
